txt: (Your pecs dance.) No more sleep it is. A frazzled ride through eternity without pause. Hissing pistons pushed to the extreme.
*All* of it.
*And* you've been recently shot in the leg.
*Fascism*, bröther.
*Never*. May this serve as a constant reminder of your sacred, un-put-downable burthen.
*Nothing* -- not pain, fatigue, hunger, fear or desire -- will ever deviate you from the path. Like an icebreaker you crush all opposition, ploughing forward *no matter what it takes*.
*Physically* he should be fine. Or at least no worse than usual...
*YOU*.
...and together we will walk the waste land of reality. Because even if you haven't had your last drink or your last line, you will never really, truly enjoy either again.
...killed a kid, yes. Makes them look for a quiet, dark place and just hibernate there. Usually goes on for a few days up to a week.
...where unidentifiable sludge makes it hard for him to breathe. Smells of vomit in here.
...wömen.
A coronary artery bypass graft? Take out his liver and replace it with a new one? Somehow undo 20 years of neurological damage from stimulants...
A correct appraisal, you're quite shabby.
A day will come when you need to take a shotgun to that cellar, shoot whatever is down there in the head, and walk away, never looking back.
A little? It's awful! The pain surges through your knuckles and then lingers there... slowly pulsating, reminding you of your mistake.
A man his age getting worked up like that? Better watch that blood pressure.
A mediocre athlete would pant from dragging around his body on a busted crutch -- but not you, you're thinking about *politics* with blood dripping down your thigh...
A memory from another life -- when you were young and fit.
A shameful way to treat a former king, even one as underwhelming as Frissel.
A shit-test is something wömen give men to see how strong their frame is, how confident they are. Fail it and they'll bail for another, more dominant alpha-male. It's in their nature.
A single sentence would wear him out. He can't take the *length* of the questioning. Keep it going long enough and he'll crack.
A sudden vibration passes through your small intestine. Like a buzzer.
Abort! Abort! No... shit, it's too late!
Absolutely. You'd never do something like that to yourself, nope.
Actually, yeah... How? You have mediocre lungs.
Air moves in your windpipe. Your heart beats. You're a detective -- get back to detecting.
All you feel is pain and weakness. You have to surrender now. We all do, it gets *so* dark. You don't even see her face, like you always thought you would. You only see pain and fear.
Almost gave you a heart attack, that one...
Alright, let's do this -- before anyone changes their mind!
An acidic smile on her lips. It's getting worse every year.
And something more. Something deeper rooted, like a sickness.
And that doesn't even *begin* to cover what's happened to your wömen...
And, let's be honest, there's a little chest pain -- the *good* kind, of course. You may wanna blast a Nosaphed or something.
Are you sure you can take the most violent man in Revachol? In your condition?
Are you sure you don't *already* have lung cancer?

As you breathe in, the odour comes over you. It's a spell of the mind telling you to run -- and your stomach to wring itself empty. With your hands at your sides and your eyes squinting you stand in it.
As your mind works, the beat recedes from your ears. You hear your own blood pulsing through your head, nourishing your thoughts with oxygen. The rhythm is familiar...
Back there, in your sleep. All the weak-willed delinquents, dilly-dalliers, foreign moneylenders, insane anarchists, and yes -- the wöömen -- they've run this place to ruin.
Be that as it may, it might have been useful to have such a thing for the trials you'll soon be facing. It's a shame you can't get your hands on these ingredients.
Because you've said the hard things, that others won't say. The gööd things. You've said them many times.
Before you say anything, ask yourself. Is the woman really able to *withstand* the truth?
Brother, you've managed to collect all the armour pieces. Too bad it's too late for the big showdown.
Bröther. You *have* succeeded...
Bröther... this one might know how to turn back time.
Buckle up and raise your collar -- this search is going to be wet and cold.
Bullseye! (A reassuring rumble in your guts.) And *that's* the vibe we're looking for. *Those* are the people with answers.
But just imagine... to go back with the knowledge and the experience you now have and do it all over. Do it *richtig* this time?
But still... he's definitely one of us. Longs for the Old Days - the *Old Ways*. He's likely to know how to turn back time. Ask him!
But there *is* one more kingsman to confront.
But this guy does. He's a bulwark, a Defender of the Evening Lands. He may know how to turn back time...
But you did. Not with words, but you *did*, bröther. (The tightness spreads to your gut.)
Can't hear you over the moans of your wömen. They writhe in pleasure as the foreigners are playing them like instruments. Be careful, or they'll wear you like a sock, Harry.
Clearly that wasn't enough. You have to do something *drastic* to get under his skin and open him up.
Come to think of it, she *does* look incredibly tired.
Coughs a lot.
Could it be an underlying condition aggravated by years of greasy meals scarfed down between shifts? Or the litres upon litres of hard liquor guzzled on an empty stomach?
Could it be psychological? Because your physical health is fine.
Damage.
Death *is* scary. You can't just start over again. Or can you?
Deep satisfying rumble runs through your small intestine. It feels affirming.
Despite doubt, fear, sentimentality and weakness, you plough ever forward, like an icebreaker, tearing through the frigid North Sea.
Digging them.
Do it -- *if you want to die*, the stabbing pain in your chest is telling you. You're hanging by a thread here...
Do you know what today is?
Does someone feel like throwing up? I do. A little.
Don't be ridiculous. They are all men, trust me.
Don't get too excited. Clarity is still many months away for you -- difficult, confusing, very emotional months. Shall we keep going?
Don't think this is a sign of anything other than your heart failing.
Don't worry, he doesn't know anything useful, the man's almost expired. No fire in him. But *you* will carry on the flame. *Semper fidelis*, kingsman, anything is possible.
Duty, medals, honour, chain of command -- I like this guy. He's not a pansy. I don't like pansies.
Eight hours, huh? Seems doable. Your machinery could go the distance if called upon...
Eight hours? There's no way. Your equipment would be mashed to jelly.
Ending him.
Enough. The Franconigerian Court of Honour has held your naked soul up against the Sevenfold Sun Miracle and looked right through it. Close your eyes and *know*, this is who you are:
Especially love, bröther. Face it, no one's willing to make the sacrifices that are necessary, not in this day and age.
Even your body has failed you. It's a miracle you didn't injure yourself.
Evening falls. The time has come to take the vows.
Exactly!
Exactly. The seagull does what it takes -- and so do you. You've got that same spirit in you. When the time comes, you'll push yourself.
Face it, bröther. No one's got the *willpower* to build her up again. They won't do what has to be done.
Face it, bröther. No one's got the *willpower* to set things right. They won't do what it takes.
Fine... The three of you, all together, ride an aerostatic into the sunset. The question remains: Will you sacrifice love to keep Revachol safe?
For Revachol. Always and only Revachol.
For the nation... smart. Best not to mention *the wömen issue* too often. People are not ready.
For the nation... smart. Best not to mention *the wömen* too often. That's why you're the head and I am the stomach.
Four is a good number of traditionalists. It's *plenty*. Let's go see what they know.
Fragile, unshielded, her voice is thin and tired.
Fuck sleep. Despite the headache -- and the queasiness -- you feel like you've got at least a ten kilometre run in you.
Fuck that cough. It's not happening. The insides of your lungs are lined with *tobacco*, a powerful antibacterial agent. You are unstoppable.
Furthermore -- they have NO IDEA how hard it is to simply remove a body from a tree.
Föminist? No! It can't be. Not you. No one believes this.
Garbage. You're a *true* patriot and you know how it's said. The Suresne way. The *fine* way. With an elegant shhh...
Go out and run circles around the building until you come up with something. Whatever you do, don't stand here anymore.
God, you're so frail. Too frail to think further, time is running out...
Good boy.
Grill him a bit, see how he performs under pressure.
Have you engaged the shit compressor? This task won't permit any looseness on your part, mentally or physically...
Have you really been wearing that decadent homo-sexual grin this whole time? It's disgusting. No wonder you haven't been able to *truly face yourself*.
He does not sound well at all.
He doesn't have the stamina to deliver mail on these tough streets. But *you* do. Maybe if this cop thing doesn't work out...
He doesn't know anything, he's too old. Doesn't have that *fire* in him anymore. But no worries, *we* will carry on. *Semper fidelis*, kingsman!
He has an idea of what he wants but he's not giving it away. Sign of a veteran dealer -- able to withstand negotiations over minuscule amounts for *days* or even *weeks*.
He is growing truly tired of it, it's not merely moodiness. His tolerance limit is near.
He looks like he's cold out here at the tip of the coast. The jacket is warm, but not for this weather.
He seems ill-equipped for wherever he’s going. A king should not go about unarmed.
He takes the dangers and discomforts that come with his work for granted, but just imagine the unforgiving desert heat he's endured, the wetlands filled with venomous reptiles he has crossed...
He will. He has it in him.
He's breathing heavily. That took something out of him.
He's exaggerating. It bites, but only a little.
He's going to live to be five hundred years old.
He's got a point. You're never going to turn back time if you don't understand how the pieces move. Let's find someone *rich* (that's how you know they've got the basics down) and pick their brain.
He's so exhausted following recent events, he doesn't even have the energy to really get on your case.
He's too banged up himself -- to talk torque with you.
His own *heart*.
His smoking, his hunched back... you have it worse, but he took a real beating. That cigarette has *medicinal* purposes.
His spirit may be willing, but his body might be too old to endure the rigours of the coast.
History will remember us, and this time we don't have to worry about her being kind. *Praeterita redire*, kingsman. Charge for Revachol, charge for *love*!
Hit the pads as fast as you can, maximum attack -- not even a bullet can get through!
Hold up. Don't go it alone -- it's a marathon, and you'll need support. Get Kim before you go any further.
I don't know... probably. I'm not a doctor.
I know you don't. But the thought still comes -- she was hibernating after doing it. Takes a moment to shake it out of your head...
I think she's just tired. She doesn't know what you meant by that -- and can you blame her?
I will send you back to the time when the sun had not yet vanished, when it was still setting into the sea. The time of the Suzerain, the time when love was still possible.
I'm not squishy and permeable. I'm bark, sap and steel. Cast me in ceramic shell, but only for *ritual purposes*. It would adorn me well... bring me to attention.
I'm satisfied. Are you satisfied? Because I am.
If he doesn't stop soon, he's going to collapse from exhaustion. He's red all over.
If you can keep the vomit in. Because it sort of also makes you want to throw up.
If you can stomach agreeing, you can turn this around on Evrart. And physically speaking -- you *can* stomach it.
In his mind, his father isn't vulnerable the way other mortals are.
In other words, it doesn't mean a thing to *trüe* Revacholians.
In this vision of hers, you are mutually opportunistic organisms. Growing like mould on the streets.
Indeed. You don't strike yourself like a powerhouse at all.
Is it some kind of performance enhancement supplement?
Is there anything -- *anything* -- we could use to protect this frail body? That gun will tear us to pieces.
It *is* possible to live with an injury like that. Makes you touch the back of your skull, wondering if there's one in there?
It can, and it *is*. Just a mountain of shit, every bit of it.
It could be worse. So much worse.
It has, bröther, but we are going to turn back time! (A solemn gurgle emanates from your stomach.)
It is one of betrayal and disappointment.
It sounds like you're having a heart attack -- whatever you said, it couldn't have been *that* bad. Please relax.
It takes a true kingsman to summon the *will* to face reality in all its darkness. To stare straight into the abyss and do *what must be done*.
It takes a while for that shit to get out of your system, and for reality to come back into focus.
It turns out you've already been wearing your *true* face. The face of The Loser. The face of He Who Could Not Handle It. Now, get out of your sight.
It was time to banish that pitiful, *sad* look from your face -- and replace it with a perfect reflection of your unyielding resolve, your noble suffering.
It was time to banish that ridiculous *Expression* from your face -- and replace it with a perfect reflection of your unyielding resolve, your noble suffering.
It wasn't enough. You simply don't have what it *takes*...
It'll take a few moments for him to recover.
It's a *gut feeling*. He knows it exists, fuck the so-called *specialists*.
It's a long *healthy* trek back to the village.
It's all shit.
It's an image of you that will stand the test of time. People will remember this for an age.
It's clear you like the hard stuff, bröther.

It's especially painful this time. You've thrown up so much there's nary anything left down there. Hot tears of pain streak down your face -- you're crying too. Crying and convulsing at the same time.
It's gonna be hard to say them. Carrying around all that weight on a busted crutch is making you pant...
It's his heart.
It's meant to keep you safe.
It's more likely he can handle the smell. Unlike you.
It's not your moves that are at fault, per se. You almost certainly had a seizure just now -- and a much more massive one a few days ago, when you lost your memory.
It's probably this way of thinking that got you where you are.
It's time to face yourself, mano y mano. The next time you find yourself alone before a mirror. *That's* where this will end... The final showdown.
It's time to face yourself, mano y mano. The next time you find yourself alone before a mirror. *That's* where this will end...
It's time you knew the truth, bröther.
It's time. Time to see yourself as you truly are. It's going to be absolutely *devastating*, but there's no way to avoid it.
It's time. Your efforts at avoiding this moment have been truly *heroic*, but now there's nothing left but for you to confront yourself as you *truly* are, no matter the consequences...
It's your first day sober.
It's your own fault if you're ill, got it.

It’s breaking. You feel fractures across you. Out the cracks comes nothing at all. No king, no man, and no king’s man. The cracks were all there ever was. We are a spiderweb of glass that’s painful to look at. And she’s turning her head.
Keep it in now. Don't overreact. Breathe.
Let this new face be a reminder, an unalterable mark of shame. This is the face of The Loser, the face of He Who Looks at Himself and Despairs. Now, get out of your sight.
Let's hope so. It's beginning to seem possible that you *will* solve it.
Liquid parts mostly, and you're quickly running out of them. There is a major artery on the inside of the thigh...
Look at yourself: You go about with this mopey look on your face like a dog who's been beaten with an old stick.
Look deep inside yourself. You know it's true, because it *hurts*.
Love... time... Revachol... all of it. The pressure is putting you on your knees.
Love... time... Revachol...
Lower intestine? The term is METABOLIC AND CIRCULATORY SYSTEM.
Lying will get you nowhere. You can't outrun the truth -- it will catch up to you one day.
Many things, but it's möstly about trusting your gut. Who does your gut tell you is the source of Revachol's problems?
Mauled by a nightmare. Bite marks in his bones.
Maybe don't beat yourself any more though? You're not immortal.
Maybe if you're some kind of binoclard. *You* on the other hand, are a gut-thinker, through and through.
Maybe you were wrong. She's endured for at least four decades in this world.
Measurehead is *exactly* the kind of man who'd know how to step back into the past.
Merely standing up makes you sweat profusely. Your breathing is erratic. Your own heartbeat in your ears grows frantic and you feel your blood pressure rise.
More cardio? Let's *do* this.
Natural selection.
Never -- not until the case is solved. And then the next case. And the next...
No love for Möther Oranje? Wasn't he a *söldier*?
No point in worrying about it just now. Why don't you get back to the story?
No time for that sentimental bullshit. They're hustlers, getting shit done. They're one pair of track pants away from gangsters. Just like you.
No worries, just a small setback. *Movere tempore*, kingsman. For the tenacious no road is impassable. Just got to stay moving.
No! No! Hold on.
No, believe it or not, this isn't about *her*. Well, not exactly...
No, bröther, forget about your gut, we've got much more pressing matters to focus on. It’s time to *turn back time*. (A solemn gurgle emanates from the depths of your stomach.)
No, it's *far* too late. All that remains is for you to feel bad, because you failed, and there's nothing you can do about it. That is the way of the world...
No, no. When the blööd and the flesh call, there is no discarding them. Speak true, do you like *the hard stuff*?
No, not her. She's a woman. Anyone else?
No, you don't. It's been too long since this has happened for you to recognize the feeling.
No, you don't. You're well into detoxing now. *Reality* is beginning to come into focus -- just look around.
No, you should own up to it, claim it as *yours*. Forget about the haters.
No-no-no... you'll never figure out how to turn back time if you're not honest with her. Explain what's going on with you.
No. It's many years of combined self-neglect and self-abuse.
No. She reached the end of her elasticity about two months ago -- from here on out, every chip and knick and blow stays in there somewhere.
No. Well, it might be, but you don't have your badge, so how would you know? Try again.
No. You can do it. You still have plenty of juice in you before you drop.
Nope, sorry, you don't. Not this time.
Not so sure about the last part, with all that drinking...
Not that he has to worry about getting old yet -- he's sparkling with youth, a radiant demi-god.
Not you. You are an *eternal machine*.
Nothing to see here but disrespect. The old figure will outlive this pathetic lick of paint. The past always endures.
Nothing wrong with raw ambition.
Now *there* is man who values the past with passion. And you know how the saying goes: He who clings to the past, shapes the future.
Now open your eyes and witness the (small) wonder! The HMS Modest Kingsman has left the docks. You are neither the greatest nor the strongest icebreaker on the seas, but you are what you are.
Now open your eyes and witness the wonder! The HMS Last Kingsman has left the docks. The world will tremble as you smash all the ice in the world.
Now shout from the top of your lungs: YOU ARE THE NOBLE SUFFERER.
Now we're making bank! A man with *guts* and a *memory*. I felt it too. He could be a treasure trove of wisdom. Who else?

Now, every night, while you masturbate in the ruins of your not-so-great-anymore hall, they're getting pleasured by foreign men with superior testosterone levels and *far* more advanced sexual practices than your feeble grunt-and-thrust.
Of course you are, bröther. Of course. (A wink-shaped growl sounds from your ass.)
Of course. It's been too long since this has happened for you to recognize the feeling.
Oh yeah, he's definitely one of us. Smart one too, tactical. He might very well know how to turn back time. Ask him!
Oh yeah... *big boy time*. This needs you to put your BACK into it.

Oh yes, they're all *wiped out*. Your bushels of grain, your salted meats, your hogsheads brimming with bitter ale. All gone. Your fields have been put to the torch, your great-hall is a ravaged husk. You are bereft.
Oh yes, they're all gone. Carried off by foreign invaders because you failed to uphold your most ancient and noble vöws. The worst part is they might even *prefer* it this way...
Oh yes. (Your lower intestine rumbles approvingly.) Gary is *exactly* the kind of guy we want. He knows something! Who else?
Okay, don't worry -- that's what your gut is for, *feeling* these things out. Let me be your eyes and when I know for sure someone's got that special *something*, I'll tip you off.
One stroke? Don't be so modest. He's having one right now.
Only the most average survive Extinction-Level Events. That's a known fact.
Or maybe it's just his body and mind giving up on him, at last...
Own it! Steal hot dogs, shit in the sand -- whatever it takes to keep going!
People whose yearning for the past is so great they barely live in the present. Those are the men you need to find. Those are the guys who'd know.
Phew! All that nodding was rough on the old neck. Close to feeling that twinge...
Protect the Suzerainty, clean up the city, revive disco music, and get her back? You could save Revachol. You could be the *man*, bröther.
Quit stalling, bröther! We were talking about the weakest, worst, most insane thing. The weak link!
Remember, bröther, you say the hard things -- the gööd things. Most folk haven't got the stomach for it.

Remember: Kingsmen are not born, they are made. And the only thing that can unmake us is that which drove us to rise above in the first place. We keep that thing locked in the deepest cellars of our mind. So deep we forget what it is.
Right.
Rotten Human Meat-Ceramic Boot Soup? Nope, you really shouldn't.
Rust, moss, and sea life have already claimed it for themselves and initiated a slow decomposition process.
Say what you will, but this kid's *hard shit*. He might actually make a good cop one day.
Second chances are not about questions, they are about actions. Are you ready to start taking action, bröther?
Seemed neurological... central nervous system's really banged up.
Seems like it isn't working, bröther... maybe you should try talking to other traditionalists instead.
She can't take much more. Her stomach is churning. Soon she will have to go to the bathroom and scream.
She must be very cold. And exhausted of this life.
She'll go out in a hail of bullets if she has to.
She's not lying now. She really is very tired. Her metabolism is failing her, the afterglow of whatever narcotics she's been taking is wearing off.
She's not. She's bleeding out. If she doesn't get help in 10 minutes, she'll die.
She's not. She's bleeding out. In 20 minutes she'll be dead. Maybe 15.
She's right. Something wants to come out -- through your mouth. But you can keep it down because your body does not control you.
She's trying to avoid the foreigners part. This is because she's a woman. She may be *lying* to you...
Should have just eaten the damn thing.
So ask yourself, when the time comes, can you shoot the past in the head, walk away, and never look back on its rotting remains?
Something about his notion gives you strength. Makes you realize this isn't the end of the road yet.
Something moves in your gut. It's almost like a tug.
Soon you'll be looking for clues in a pile of sludge and bones.
Sounds like their bodies just haven't been *crushed* enough yet.
Speaking of, *your* gut's seen better days. It's a cesspool of burbling acids and noxious fumes, the kind of thing the government might declare a Zone of Irredeemable Catastrophe.
Still rather inviting, all things considered. It's much warmer inside than out there...
Stomach truth. You're having a stomach *truth*.
Stop. There's nothing else she can do for you, but this isn't the end of the line. No, there's one more kingsman to confront.
Suddenly you realize how hungry you are. The last time you ate must have been... god knows when.
Sure, *inside*. But outside it's a tough world. You've got to do whatever it takes to survive. And you *do*. Question is: will you admit that to yourself?
Sure, sure, but that guy -- you wouldn't tell it by his looks, but he is *definitely* a bröther and a kingsman. Ask if he knows how to turn back time!
Sure. Revachol will do just fine without you. Don't worry about her.
Sweat drips from your brow, soaking your chest... you reek of it, your chemicals.
Take a deep breath. Best to go one piece at a time.
Technically speaking, you *could* rest here if you're hurting... someone else has. It should be possible.
Teeming with opportunistic micro-organisms, letting out a foul-smelling diamine compound. Your eyes turn watery...
Tell him the truth, bröther. Even if he isn't *hard* enough to hear it.
Thank you for the compliment. We could manage it even in wooden clogs. There are uncanny running-reservoirs in this body -- god knows why...
That explains the callouses on your hands. You scaled the side of the building, entertaining the local kids.

That stupid *Expression* was your last line of defence, but now even that has collapsed. The combined armies of Pain and Shit are streaming through your gates, pillaging your stores, carrying off your wömen...
That's a good number of traditionalists. It's *ample*. Let's go see what they know.
That's an illusion. Your breathing is just as it was and will remain that way unless you start panicking.
That's because some them just don't have the best interests of the colony in mind.
That's not a healthy look. Muscles get bigger, heart grows weaker.
That's okay with the fat man, still wheezing there. He couldn't speak if he wanted to.
That's our guy! The way he speaks about the war and the bygone days -- Kingsman through and through -- ask him how to turn back time!
That's right. You're protected in your ceramic carapace. Whatever harm you inflict on that world won't be visited on you.
That's what fascism boils down to. The rest is also important, but the *main thing* is that wömen need to *know their place*.
The *incredible* stamina output...
The Royal Lion. Guillaume's Kitten. This knocker will last a lifetime and then some.
The Vows of Blööd and Flesh.

The abstract shapes swelling in the foreground have done so in vain. This is a core matter. The answer, in the double-kick that moves the millilitres through your mind. The dark thud is the source of all rhythm, the inspiration behind mathematics...
The ammonia only makes it worse! The combination forces tears out of your ducts. You manage to keep it in once...
The bed is quite inviting, all things considered. It's much warmer inside than out there...
The bloated whores, schizophrenic anarchists and deformed moneylenders tremble, trying to shield their eyes, as he -- *Le gendarme en diamant* -- walks by!
The bloating *has* gone down since you woke up that morning...
The carabineer is too old and feeble to be useful. But you will carry on. *Movere tempore*, kingsman. For the tenacious no road is impassable.
The elements are rough around here. I don't know about this...
The firewalker cannot die.
The game was rigged from before you even knew how the pieces move, söldier. (The tightness spreads to your gut.)
The handset starts slipping from your sweaty palm... your breathing is heavy.
The hard core.
The iron smell of blood rises to your mouth.
The lieutenant is right. It's the only way forward. Face yourself, kingsman!
The money is probably going to some old, oily...
The nodding's reaching critical mass! You can't take this much longer, captain!
The pain in your chest tells you you were working yourself to death to earn that rank.
The problem is obvious: You simply can't hack it. You're a failure. It's all *too much* for you.
The raw, robust stamina output...
The rumbling in your stomach says there's something not quite right with this one...
The second time -- not so much. When the vomiting is done your cheeks are wet with tears.
The smell is repulsive. It pushes in from your mouth, more instant and more familiar than anything you'd expected; more fever than odour. It fills your mind, flushing you from within.
The strength has all gone out of him -- just frail old bones in a sack of tracksuit trousers and a wind breaker.
The torment Lieutenant Kitsuragi is experiencing is worse than your own, but he's slowly beginning to recover.
The torment Lieutenant Kitsuragi is experiencing is worse than your own. He's trying to resist, but there's no way of knowing when he will recover.
The wind picks up. Fine sea foam lashes your face. It feels like needles. You can take it -- just raise your collar, detective.
Then their paradise became *shit city*. And what did they do? They became urban survivors! Eating burgers out of trash cans! Killing and eating pigeons!
There is a *slight* physical revulsion in him while saying that, but he's worked through it in the intervening years.
There might be a little bile gathering at the back of your throat, but it's just a taste. The source of this issue is higher up the wire...
There must be others like you. Men, who long for the days when words like 'loyalty' and 'love' meant something.
There's a lever in front of you. Pull it, and atomic fire blankets your beloved Revachol. Millions die in an instant. But you are spared. You, and the voice in the payphone.
There's a slow, painful growl somewhere in your intestines, knocking on your alcohol-engorged liver...
There's definitely something off with his body. Something more than just metabolism, or even cancer...
There's definitely something off with his body. Something more than just metabolism...
There's no shame in surrendering now. We all do, it gets *so* dark. You don't even see her face, like you always thought you would. You only see pain and fear.

This again? But you've learned the basics... Guess we need to return to Mr. Monolith once we've figured out what else is missing from the curriculum.
This again? Guess we need to return to Mr. Monolith once we've gotten a better understanding of the whole 'reality thing'.
This fool is a colossal waste of time. There's no kingsman inside him -- just self-loathing and entitlement. Let's keep searching.
This guy has proved to be a dead end. (A dissatisfied growl in you abdomen.) But the hard endure and the true kingsman keeps searching. 'Vaillance,' brööder, the night is darkest before the dawn.
This idiocy has gone on far too long. It's time to wipe that decadent homo-sexual grin off your face. Time to see yourself as you truly are.
This idiocy has gone on too long. It's time to wipe that decadent homo-sexual grin off your face.

This jacket is the apex of human evolution -- the moment at which man became weatherproof.

Through tears and blood and stitches tearing it *should* be possible. From time to time...
Through tears and blood and stitches tearing it *should* be possible.
To go back with the knowledge and the experience you have now and do it all over? Do it *richtig* this time?

Walks are fucking *great* cardio. Very stable fat-burner. Aerobic exercise.

We keep it buried like a horrible secret. We feed it through the cracks in the floorboards out of a sickening sense of nostalgia. Just enough to keep it alive. And yet it still comes to us in moments of weakness, unbidden, a source of shame and panic...
We were right. This came from a serious weapon.
We're pulling the plug on this. Nothing else to be done. Good luck, everyone.
What are you doing? This woman might be your only chance to figure out how to reverse time... Grow a pair!
What was *that*? Did you just *flinch* before your own reflection?
What's that? Can't hear yourself over the moans of your wömen in the hands of foreigners who play them like instruments. Be careful, or they'll wear you like a sock, Harry-boy.
What? Kim? No, it's you! You! You and the seagull are just alike!
Whatever it is about this woman, it's connected to *time* -- she knows the way back.
Whew, got off lucky there... that could have resulted in a world of hurt.
Whew, got off really lucky... that could have resulted in a world of hurt.

While the world burns, the two of you, together again, ride an aerostatic into the sunset. Maybe it will work this time? Spare Revachol and you'll never hear from her again. Will you sacrifice a second chance at love to keep Revachol safe?
Who said anything about giving up?

Whoah. After so much drinking *and* drugs -- how did they manage it?

You crack open the ammonia ampoule and breathe in. The odour of death is still stronger. It's a spell of the mind telling you to run -- and your stomach to wring itself empty. With your eyes squinting you stand in it.

You have. The body remembers.

You try to -- very professionally -- look at the corpse, but your stomach contracts. You manage to keep it in once...

You were right, bröther. (There's a sudden tightness in your lower intestine.)

You! You and the seagull are just alike!
